patterns.note: Full-bleed, distinct sections with contrasting background colors (red, grey) that occupy the full viewport height during transitions.
Extremely large, custom-designed display typography used for hero text and logo, which undergoes visual transformation on scroll.
High-contrast, limited palette of primary red, cool grey, and electric blue, with black and white used for text and subtle accents.
Dramatic, multi-stage scroll-triggered transformations of the hero section, including background color changes, content swaps (video to static image), and a morphing logo text.
Content is presented in distinct, full-viewport-height sections that transition into one another with a 'page-turn' or 'reveal' effect on scroll.

technique_notes: The site uses scroll-triggered animations (leveraging css-keyframes and potentially JavaScript for complex sequencing) to create a highly dynamic experience. The initial hero section dramatically transforms on scroll, changing its background color, replacing video content with static imagery and new text, and morphing the main logo text. Subsequent sections reveal with a full-viewport transition, maintaining a sense of distinct 'pages' within a single scroll. Sticky elements like the 'INFO' button and social icons adjust their position and appearance based on scroll depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, custom-designed display headings (~8-10x body) with a very strong, bold character, contrasted with small, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy and spacious, especially in hero and section transitions, creating a sense of grandeur and focus on individual elements.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the theatrical, almost performative scroll experience, where the entire hero section dramatically transforms its content, background, and even the main logo text in a multi-stage animation. This creates a strong sense of narrative progression and visual surprise as the user scrolls, making the interaction itself a core part of the brand experience.
